10 miles north of Yankton, moving east at 30 mph.

roofs, siding, and trees.

central Yankton County, including the following locations...
Lesterville.

* WHAT...Southwest winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt.

* WHERE...Pohnpei Coastal Waters.

* WHEN...From 3 AM Wednesday to 3 AM ChST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...A monsoon surge will bring increased winds to
Pohnpei by Wednesday morning and will maintain strong winds with
frequent gusts up to 30 knots through Wednesday morning. Winds
should subside Wednesday as the surge weakens across the region.

events.region: San Diego County Coastal Areas; Orange County Coastal
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 4 to 7 feet with sets up to 9
feet, highest at south and southwest-facing beaches. Strong
and dangerous rip and longshore currents. Minor coastal
flooding from a combination of high surf and high astronomical
tides during the evenings.

* WHERE...Beaches of Orange and San Diego Counties.

* WHEN...Through 11 PM PDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with isolated
road closures expected. Dangerous swimming and surfing
conditions and beach erosion.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Predicted higher high tides:

Newport Beach: Tuesday: 7.0 feet at 7:59 PM.

La Jolla: Tuesday: High 6.9 feet at 7:54 PM PDT.
